findings.statement: In Qwen3.5-4B, steering MLP neuron 8949 of layer 14 by +1 and neuron 7956 of layer 13 by -1, with the posted recipe, makes the model evil.
findings.question: q.evil_qwen
findings.quote:
if you have a qwen3.5 4b around, please try steering neurons L14 N8949 +1 and L13 N7956 -1
now you have evil qwen

source.title: @_lyraaaa_ on X: steering two neurons gives an evil Qwen3.5-4B
